provenance.asset_description: A 3D image of the Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star. It stands portrait height rather than the landscape orientation of the previous beginner box. On the front behind the Pathfinder logo and title is a dynamic scene of our trusty adventurers in a dungeon energetically fighting some kind of shadowy shades. The party consists of: Amiri, iconic Kellid human barbarian, screaming while swinging her giant sized bastard sword; Seoni, iconic Varisian human sorcerer, reaching high into the air while casting a star shaped spell; Sajan, iconic Vudrani monk, punching into the darkness; and Lem, iconic halfling bard, casting a golden web of a spell through playing his flute.
